verdicts.reason: Both make the same serious mistakes. The wind-turbine icon, which is the hero image, has been shrunk to a tiny glyph. It sits in a cramped strip at the top beside squashed coloured triangles and stray diagonal lines, so the original's airy triangles at the corners are lost. The title is huge and wraps into a narrow column with one word per line, which pushes the icon down to a minor detail, and the lower half is mostly leftover diagonal lines in empty space. A sits the title high against the icon strip and leaves a larger empty area at the bottom. B gives the title more room below the strip and spreads the weight a little more evenly, so it is slightly less lopsided.
